title: NASA SoFIE-GEL microgravity solid-fuel flame extinction cases
status: source-transcribed experimental case summary; not raw telemetry
investigation: Solid Fuel Ignition and Extinction – Growth and Extinction Limit (SoFIE-GEL)

records.source_reference: Table 1, page 3; heat loss explicitly marked not recorded

extinction_velocity_or_limit.available: Flow velocity and oxygen concentration at extinction for five cases; these are case conditions, not a complete extinction-boundary map.

radiant_heat_flux.note: The paper reports conductive heat loss for four cases, not calibrated radiant heat flux.

peak_surface_temperature.note: The setup describes embedded thermocouples and subsurface temperature gradients, but this paper's five-case table does not provide peak surface temperature.

flame_spread_rate.note: For Case 4, the paper reports a peak flame-tip pulsation speed of about 25 cm/s. This is not a steady solid-surface flame-spread rate.

gravity_comparison.earth: The paper discusses comparison with normal-gravity modeling/context, but this five-case table contains no Earth-gravity experimental records.

missing_value_convention: null means the cited source does not report a value; it must not be interpreted as zero.

source.title: Extinction of solid diffusion flame in microgravity: details of quenching and blowoff processes
source.publisher: NASA Technical Reports Server (NASA-hosted conference paper)
source.doi_note: No DOI is stated in the NASA-hosted source document. Do not substitute a related journal article DOI for this source.

provenance_note: Values are transcribed from the cited NASA-hosted paper. This is a compact publication-level case dataset, not the complete SoFIE-GEL telemetry/video archive. No values have been interpolated or inferred.
